why: B is A turned upside down: the dip becomes a hill, the arrow now points downward, and the little flag hangs down with its loop on the other side of the stick. Doing the same to C gives a dip on the left with the flag hanging down (loop on the right) and the arrow on the hill pointing down-left: option 1. Option 3 has the loop on the wrong side, and option 5 has the arrow pointing down-right.
trick: For flip questions, check every small detail: which side the loop is on and which way the arrow points.
